title: About X-Ample Development
subtitle: We build Discord bots, websites, and web apps with clean UX, performance-first code, and support you can rely on.
body:
X-Ample Development (also known as X-Ample Studios) is a development studio focused on Discord bots, websites, and custom web applications.

We focus on readable UI, practical features, and maintainable code that scales with your community or business. We also handle bug hunting, performance fixes, and optimization so your projects run smoothly.

Whether you're launching a new community tool, upgrading an existing site, or need something fixed or polished, we ship quality work and can take on custom development when you need something bespoke.

highlights.title: Quality first
highlights.body: Consistent UI, sensible defaults, and attention to detail.

highlights.title: Performance-minded
highlights.body: Built to run smoothly and scale with your traffic and community size.

highlights.title: Support & iteration
highlights.body: We listen, fix issues quickly, and keep improving.

highlights.title: Security first
highlights.body: Security is our top priority; we keep bots and apps secure and up to date.

highlights.title: Privacy focused
highlights.body: We ensure our work is privacy-focused and does not collect personal data without need.
